爱莎贝儿-148CM-L 粉肤 RAD009 松坂绘里奈Matsuzaka Erina-甜蜜的暧昧
她妩媚地轻笑，眼神如火般撩人，
肆意张扬地舒展曼妙身姿，热情火辣地贴近他。
薄纱下的曲线若隐若现，她柔软的身体轻轻摩挲，
吐气如兰，低语道：“今晚，我只属于你。”
心跳加速，空气中弥漫着甜蜜的暧昧，
她如火焰般热情缠绵，尽情释放内心的炽热。
身型：148CM-L 粉肤

Elsa Babe-148CM-L Pink RAD009 Matsuzaka Erina-Sweet Ambiguity
She smiled alluringly, her eyes fiery and captivating,
unrestrainedly displaying her graceful figure, passionately pressing herself against him.
The curves under the gauze are faintly visible, her soft body gently caressed, breathing like orchids, whispering, "Tonight, I belong only to you."
His heart raced, the air filled with sweet ambiguity,
she entwined him with fiery passion, releasing the burning desire within him.
Body type: 148CM-L with Pink skin tone.
